args.stdin: WITH product AS (SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_variant_properties pvp1 ON pv.product_sku = pvp1.product_sku AND pvp1.property_key = 'storage_type' AND pvp1.property_value_text = 'tool bag' JOIN product_variant_properties pvp2 ON pv.product_sku = pvp2.product_sku AND pvp2.property_key = 'color_family' AND pvp2.property_value_text = 'Gray' JOIN product_variant_properties pvp3 ON pv.product_sku = pvp3.product_sku AND pvp3.property_key = 'volume' AND (pvp3.property_value_text = '8' OR pvp3.property_value_text = '8 l') WHERE pv.brand = 'Milwaukee' AND pv.series = 'M12' AND pv.model = 'M12 2TN-F66' AND pv.product_name LIKE '%Tool Box and Bag%' LIMIT 1) SELECT p.product_sku, p.record_path, COALESCE(SUM(si.available_today_quantity), 0) AS total_count FROM product p CROSS JOIN stores s LEFT JOIN store_inventory si ON s.store_id = si.store_id AND si.product_sku = p.product_sku WHERE s.city = 'Graz' GROUP BY p.product_sku, p.record_path;
SELECT record_path FROM stores WHERE city = 'Graz';
